title: The bosun, idle frame C
prompt:
An idle frame for crew-bosun.webp (attach it): exactly the same figure, costume, colours, scale and foot position, so that laid over it only one detail moves: the weight shifted onto the other foot and the head tilted the other way. Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge, in the manner of Georges Méliès' 1903 film Le Royaume des fées: early-1900s stencil-tinted colour (sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e, grotto teal #5f8c88 and azure #6f9fc8 laid slightly out of register); no lettering; no cast shadow; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Generate one asset only, no collage or labels. True transparent background. Intended delivery 220 x 420 pixels. Keep the reference figure proportions and the entire silhouette. EDIT the attached base sprite minimally: preserve its exact canvas aspect ratio, unchanged feet, bottom baseline and full-height proportions. Only change the small detail described. Do not redesign or replace any props. CRITICAL CONTINUITY: Do NOT mirror or reverse the figure. In the reference, the lantern is at the UPPER RIGHT of the image, held in his raised right-of-image hand; it MUST remain there, at the same pixel position. The rope is over the LEFT-of-image shoulder with the left-of-image hand on the rope; it MUST remain there. Keep body, arms, lantern, rope and both boots in the same locations. Make only a tiny head tilt in the OTHER direction and a subtle waist weight shift. This is one animation frame for overlay on the base image.
